label: DEK::NUP214

sections.text: DEK encodes a chromatin-associated regulator of transcription and DNA topology.
NUP214 encodes a nuclear pore component involved in nucleocytoplasmic transport.

The t(6;9) fusion links DEK to the carboxy-terminal region of NUP214, producing an abnormal nuclear protein that alters transcriptional and proliferative programs. It defines a recurrent AML subtype and often co-occurs with FLT3-ITD.
DEK::NUP214 AML is in the adverse genetic-risk group under adult ELN 2022 intensive-treatment criteria.
